description: Compare APIs in one category on official price, free tier, MCP support, SDK downloads and status. Filters are optional.

category.description: Category slug from list_api_categories, e.g. web-search, blockchain-rpc, 3d-generation; plain words work too (speech to text)

max_price_per_1k.description: Max USD per 1,000 requests (only APIs with a per-request price)

mcp_only.description: Only APIs with an official MCP server

query.description: Optional: what you need it for, e.g. 'news search with full article text'; ranks the closest first

sort.description: Optional: cheap = lowest comparable price first, popular = most used first

name: find_apis
title: Compare APIs in a category
